properties.site-address: Berwick Eastern Arc - The Quayside, Berwick-upon-Tweed
properties.notes: Opportunity for redevelopment of a site that is currently in use for car parking in part but largely vacant. Offers an attractive riverside location for residential development. A number of applications have been permitted concerning the existing business, but they only relate to a small portion of the site (17/02027/COU, 16/01664/COU).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
